authority.summary: Drupal's configuration system records each object's module dependencies, and core.extension records which modules an export enables. An object depending on a module the same export does not enable cannot be imported as exported.

finding.assertion: A config object depends on a module the same exported configuration does not enable.

conclusion.candidate: The export appears inconsistent, though the deciding context was not fully observed.
conclusion.confirmed: The export is internally inconsistent: it carries configuration that depends on a module it does not enable.
conclusion.not_observed: Every module named by a readable config object's dependencies is enabled by the same export.
conclusion.unknown: The dependency or enablement evidence was not complete enough to compare.

finding.evidence_explanation: A config object's dependencies block names a module absent from core.extension.
finding.human_title: Exported configuration depends on a module it does not enable
limitations: Config objects the safe YAML reader cannot parse were not inspected, so this is not a claim that every dependency is satisfied.
An enabled module in exported configuration is not proof the module is enabled at runtime.

remediation.guidance: Either enable the named module in the exported configuration or remove the configuration that depends on it, then re-export.

review.authority: reviewed against the pinned default.settings.php snapshot for exported configuration semantics

scope.notes: Configuration dependencies are a Drupal 8-and-later mechanism.

summary: A config object declares a module dependency, and that module is absent from the complete list of modules the same exported core.extension enables.
title: Exported configuration depends on a module the same export does not enable
